use: line-colour stripe on the wall; the station multiplies the base by its line colour at runtime
pattern: neutral near-white painted metal #F2F2F0 with faint orange peel; the base carries no colour

uv.origin: a repeat starts at u = k x repeat_m along the wall and at v = 0 on the floor

license: CC-BY-4.0 — original GTEki work; attribution: GTEki contributors
provenance: original procedural geometry and textures; see assets/library/PROVENANCE.md

tint_info.formula: rendered base colour = albedo texture (sRGB, decoded to linear) x baseColorFactor, per channel in linear light
tint_info.set: baseColorFactor = the station line colour as linear RGB (three.js material.color.set('#rrggbb'), Godot albedo_color); leave the texture as shipped
tint_info.gain: the base is about 0.89 in linear light, so the line colour renders about 11% darker than its hex; multiply the factor by 1.12 (clamped to 1) to match the hex
